statement: Current Beancount exposes bean-check as a v3 console script, while the plugin editor linter runs bean-query .errors and can silently skip diagnostics when the executable or path is unavailable.

The operational error surface spans parser/date/account lifecycle, transaction weights, balance/pad, cost-basis lots, include graph, BQL/process, price, mutation, and CSV layers; each requires a distinct recovery check.

The plugin has no dedicated bulk CSV importer in the inspected source; safe AI import and reconciliation must preserve raw input, normalize records, write canonical files, run bean-check, and compare running balances with BQL.
